messages:
maggie.marketing: Hey team — draft of the product announce article is up (v0.6). Need a quick content + legal pass today, and confirmation on webinar/demo invite copy + inbound lead tagging. Link: https://docs.google.com/example/article-v0.6 :point_right:

sam.copy: scanning now. quick note — hero claim feels strong but slightly technical. Suggest simplifying first line to: 'Predictable, production-ready LLM inference at cloud scale.'

maggie.marketing: good — update that and keep the second para with the cost/latency bullets.

devon.growth: for the webinar CTAs we need 3 tiers: 'Try the hosted API', 'Request Dedicated trial', 'Schedule an onsite pilot'. Can we get distinct UTMs for each so we can route leads?

nate.ops: mapping suggestion (quick):
```
utm_campaign=announce_v1
utm_source=blog
utm_medium=cta
utm_content=hosted|dedicated|pilot
```
I'll add routing rules in the CRM once we lock the utm_content values.

elaine.legal: I skimmed claims. Approve the latency/cost statements as-written, but redact the sentence that says 'beats all managed vendors' — too comparative. Also flag the privacy sentence under 'Data handling' — need mention of KMS/HSM options.

sam.copy: noted. I'll remove the comparative line and add a short KMS mention: 'optional customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) supported in Private).'

alex.events: tentative webinar date 2026-05-12 (Tuesday) works. How many demo seats do we want reserved for webinar follow-ups? I recommend 8 live demos + open waitlist.

devon.growth: reserve 10 demo seats, 3 follow-ups for enterprise leads. Also ask SalesOps to prep a PQL flow for immediate outreach.

nate.ops: FYI I created two simple CRM rules to tag inbound from blog: 'blog_announce_mql' and 'blog_announce_pql' — will wire once UTMs confirmed.

maggie.marketing: workflow for approvals: Sam finalizes copy by EOD, Elaine confirms legal by 5pm, Devon finalizes CTAs/UTMs, Alex locks webinar invite + demo seat counts. If all green, publish gate opens tomorrow AM.

sam.copy: pushing edits now. small question: should we include the benchmark chart in-line or link to a separate appendix? Embedding might slow the page load.

devon.growth: link to appendix and include a 1-sentence chart takeaway in-body. We'll publish a downloadable deck for partners.

elaine.legal: approved after edits — KMS line added looks good. No other red flags.

publish-bot: Reminder: content embargo set for 2026-05-10 09:00 UTC. Please confirm final approval reactions before release. :calendar:

alex.events: locked webinar invite content and demo seat count (10). I'll send calendar invites + demo signup form after publish.

maggie.marketing: thanks all. I'll do a final sweep after Sam's edits and drop the final doc link here. :white_check_mark:
